classification.difficultyReason: Read the bounds and distinguish included and excluded endpoints on supplied number lines.

content.prompt: State the inequality shown by these number lines.

spec.description: Unit ticks labelled −4 through 4, baseline arrows at both ends and x at the right. TikZ preserves the interval above the baseline, a feature not expressible by the supplied number-line template.
spec.answerVisibility: The interval is a permanent student-visible given; the inequality is answer-only.

answer.worked: The closed circle includes $-2$; the open circle excludes $3$. The segment shows all values between them, so $-2\le x<3$.
